metadata.question: In Janaury 2020, did the city of Mahajanga experience more than 12 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall in Mahajanga, Madagascar in January 2020. This requires precipitation data. I should use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) which is a good source for rainfall data. Steps: 1. Define geometry for Mahajanga, Madagascar 2. Get CHIRPS daily precipitation data for January 2020 3. Calculate total rainfall for the month 4. Convert from mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) 5. Check if total > 12 inches For data quality: - Check if collection has data - Check if there are valid pixels after processing - Validate the calculation result CHIRPS data is in mm/day, so I'll sum all days in January 2020 and convert to inches. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const mahajanga = ee.Geometry.Point([46.3167, -15.7167]); // Mahajanga, Madagascar const startDate = '2020-01-01'; const endDate = '2020-01-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS daily precipitation const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(mahajanga); const collectionSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`January 2020 images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate total rainfall const totalPrecip = chirps.sum(); // Check valid pixels const pixelCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: mahajanga, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get total rainfall in mm and convert to inches const totalRainfallMm = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: mahajanga, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Total rainfall (mm): ${totalRainfallMm?.toFixed(2) || 'null'}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (totalRainfallMm === null || totalRainfallMm === undefined || isNaN(totalRainfallMm)) { console.log("C3"); return; } const totalRainfallInches = totalRainfallMm / 25.4; console.log(`Total rainfall (inches): ${totalRainfallInches.toFixed(2)}`); console.log(`Threshold: 12 inches`); if (totalRainfallInches > 12) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
